PluginData.Author: PhoenixTheSage
PluginData.Description:
Adds AMD FRS 2.2.1 in Space Engineers, the highest for DX11.
Optional Anomaly Shader Framework supplies object motion to prevent ghosting. When Anomaly and Rich HUD Master are loaded, settings also appear under Anomaly Shaders.
Compat: Certain rendering mods may not play nice until they use Anomaly.
